title: Filter transactions by date and export CSV
body:
Extend the ledger CLI without changing its default JSON output.

- R1: Add --since YYYY-MM-DD; include transactions on that date and later, preserving input order.
- R2: Reject impossible --since dates with a nonzero exit and an error that includes the supplied date.
- R3: Add --format csv with columns id,date,merchant,amount; correctly quote commas and preserve Unicode.
- R4: CSV with no matching transactions still prints its header.
- R5: --since and --format csv work together.
